set.body:
Goal: demonstrate that the suite detects scientifically plausible parser corruption.

Acceptance criteria:
- Mutants include swapping eyes, ignoring START configuration, reusing a prior block layout, dropping MSG, ignoring message offsets, mapping dot gaze to zero, treating all missingness as Blink, accepting HREF as pixels, discarding unknown records, omitting the final block, and losing converter provenance.
- Each mutant has at least one named test that fails for the intended semantic reason.
- Surviving mutants are classified as equivalent or become explicit coverage gaps before closure.
- Mutation receipts record mutant, command, failing suite/assertion, platform, and commit.
- Non-vacuity checks assert expected fixture record/event/message counts before universal assertions.
- The release artifact includes the required-mutant result set.
set.title: Kill targeted EyeLink semantic parser mutants
